freeze_rule: AIFC v1.0 MUST NOT be labeled FROZEN unless every required check has machine-verifiable PASS evidence. All v1.0.14 obligations remain mandatory. Exact coverage relative to a successor-declared semantic surface is not evidence that the selected surface is the complete normative semantic surface relevant to the issued question. Required-surface selection MUST itself be content-identified and authority-admissible. A proof or countermodel in an abstraction MUST NOT inherit normative force unless the abstraction relation to the normative semantics is established. Cross-formula semantic bridge identity and bridge authority are distinct. The issued entailment-method label MUST be bound to exact executable/formal semantics, and method identity is distinct from method authority. Solver capacity MUST cover the exact issued formula vocabulary; changing an atom limit or solver semantics under the same method label is forbidden. The existing entailment-question v1 identity MUST remain unchanged; stronger Git-blob-SHA1 plus raw-SHA256 source identity must be attached by a separate non-retroactive binding receipt. The solver MUST NOT execute until interpretation, compiler, coverage, surface-selection, abstraction adequacy, bridge theory, entailment-method authority, method capacity, and question-source identity requirements are all authority-admissible.
forbidden_shortcuts: any shortcut forbidden by the exact content-identified v1.0.14 predecessor release gate
claiming 100 percent normative semantic coverage when the successor itself selected an unauthorized required-surface universe
changing a required semantic surface while retaining the same semantic-surface-definition identity
injecting a different semantic coverage universe after anchors or formulas have been resolved
treating equality against a successor-declared required surface as proof that the surface is normatively complete
treating disjoint predecessor and target propositional vocabularies as a normative countermodel without an authority-admissible abstraction relation
treating a content-identified empty semantic bridge as bridge authority or abstraction adequacy
adding bridge axioms without content identity, provenance, and authority
changing finite propositional solver semantics while retaining ANCHOR_GATED_FINITE_PROPOSITIONAL_IMPLICATION_V1
changing entailment atom limits under the same method label without a new authority-admissible method binding
executing a 16-atom-bounded solver on the issued 18-atom formula pair as if capacity were established
mutating the already-issued entailment-question v1 hash to retrofit stronger source identity
claiming dual source identity for the issued question before both raw SHA-256 values are independently bound
executing the solver before semantic abstraction closure is authority-admissible
relabeling a model-level countervaluation as a normative semantic countermodel without an adequacy proof
